_readme: Skill VFX (presentation only; never read by the battle). Schema v2 (v1 still reads). A skill's effect resolves: its own entry (Skills, by skill id: beast skills, avatar actives, enemy-library skills), else the default of its primary effect type (EffectDefaults, by Key: Heal, Shield, Taunt, Stun, Burn (damage over time from a Fire source), Poison (from any other), Cleanse, BuffStat, DebuffStat, Knockback; a skill that deals damage has none and looks like its element), else its element's default (ElementDefaults: exactly one per Element, None included). Each EffectDefaults entry: Effect, played when that effect lands (also on every target a status newly lands on, and on a knocked-back target), and Aura, shown on the unit while the status or stat change lasts (Sheet at its feet (Depth Ground) or over it (Over), pulsing every PulseMs; Icon above its HP bar). An effect: Motion Projectile (flies caster -> target over TravelMs, optionally drawing Projectile) or Instant; then at impact, per target: HitStopMs freeze, Flipbook, Particles, ScreenShake (Amplitude virtual px, DurationMs), HitFlash, DamageNumber; and Layers, composited in order, each timed from the hit-stop's release (StartMs, negative = before the impact; DurationMs) with its own Blend (Alpha or Additive), Anchor (Target: each target; Area: once, the centre of every hex the targets stand on; Caster) and Depth (Ground under the units, else Over): Flipbook (Frames at Fps, Scale -> EndScale), GroundDecal (a scorch sized to EndRadius hexes, fading over FadeOutMs), Shockwave (a ring growing StartRadius -> EndRadius hexes; EndRadius 0 = the affected area's radius), RadialBurst (Count sprites flying out along their rays), Particles (a burst), Glyphs (Count rune frames circling at StartRadius, rising RisePx, turning Spin times). Sheets are sprite Names and colours palette chars from content/art/pixel/pixel-art-manifest.json; tints multiply, so tinted sheets are drawn white (Tooling/PixelArt). EnemyAura (optional): the Gloam haze every standing enemy wears, an aura (as above, plus Alpha: its peak opacity, 0.05-1, and FrameMs: its sheet's frames loop one every FrameMs, 40-2000, 0 = still) at its feet under every unit, sized to its footprint's width (1, 1.75 or 2.5 hexes), each enemy on its own phase; half as opaque under the Reduced effects setting and off under Minimal. Presentation only. Painted (on a layer of any type but Particles, on a Particles spec, or on an aura): a single painted hero frame (Sheet: a manifest sprite of one frame, Filter linear; the layer's own Sheet is then optional and a Flipbook layer needs no Frames) animated by keyframed curves over a normalized time (a layer's duration, a particle's life, an aura's pulse): Scale (multiplies its size), Rotation (turns), Alpha (times the layer's fade in/out; given, it replaces the type's own fade, a particle's life fade or an aura's breathing) and Tint (palette chars, blended); RandomSpin starts each sprite of a multi-sprite part at its own seeded angle. Painted frames are drawn linear-filtered with premultiplied blending (additive as One + One). The element defaults draw the painted per-element frames (burst, ring, decal, glyph, ember) and the status defaults the painted status frames (docs/art/hollow-art-slots.md); Phoenix's three skills keep their pixel flipbooks. Ranges and rules: BeastCraft.Vfx.VfxLibraryValidator.
